changeSet.author: otchet
changeSet.sql: ALTER TYPE dac_rule_type ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'REQUIRE_SO_DAR_APPROVAL';

column.name: description
column.value: Require approval by the Signing Official identified in the Data Access Request (DAR) prior to DAC Voting. **Cannot be used with automatically opening Data Access Requests (DARs) for all DAC members.**
